records.name: ImportDxfOption
records.raw:
"""
Options for ImportDxf as parameters without dialogs in CLO API
"""
m_bAppend:bool                       # true = add the patterns to the current garment, false = clear the garment and open the file (default false)
m_bAutoScale:bool                    # true = use the length unit declared in the file and ignore m_Scale (default true)
m_Scale:float                        # factor from file units to mm (1 = mm, 10 = cm, 25.4 = inch), 0.01-100; used when m_bAutoScale is false (default 1)
m_Angle:float                        # rotation in degrees: 0 = none, 90 = counterclockwise, -90 = clockwise; other values fail (default 0)
m_bImportPatternAnnotation:bool      # import the pattern annotation text (annotation, category, style name) (default true)
m_bAutoTraceAsInternalLines:bool     # true = create the file's internal lines as internal shapes, false = as baselines (default false)
m_SwapCuttingLineAndSewingLine:bool  # swap the cutting line and the sewing line (default false)
m_bIncludeNotchs:bool                # move the notches with the swapped lines; used with m_SwapCuttingLineAndSewingLine (default false)
m_bAutoDistribute:bool               # spread the imported patterns out in the 2D window (default false)
m_bOptimizeAllCurvePoints:bool       # optimize the curve points of the imported patterns automatically (default false)
m_bImportAllDrawCurvePoint:bool      # import the draw-curve points when the curve is not loaded (default false)
m_bRemoveNonGradingPoints:bool       # remove curve points that have no grading rule (default false)
m_bConvertToSeamAllowance:bool       # deprecated and ignored: a seam allowance in the file is converted automatically (default false)
m_bImportNotchTo:bool                # import the file's notches; where they go is m_eNotchImportPlacement (default true)
m_eNotchImportPlacement:int          # where notches go: 0 = pattern outline, 1 = seam allowance, 2 = both (default; other values become 2)

records.name: ImportExportOption
records.raw:
"""
Options for Export OBJ and Export GLTF as parameters without dialogs in CLO API
"""
bExportGarment:bool                    # true : Export Garment (Cloth Meshes)
bExportAvatar:bool                     # true : Export Avatar (Avatar Meshes)
bSingleObject:bool                     # true : OBJ single object, false : OBJ multiple object
weldType:WELD_TYPE                     # FULLY_UNWELDED : unweld, FULLY_WELDED : weld, SELECTED_WELDED : Weld selected patterns in workspace, DEFAULT_WELDED : Do not use!!!
bThin:bool                             # if true, export the garment as thin mesh. Otherwise, export it as thick mesh.
bUnifiedUVCoordinates:bool             # [Deprecated] - Please use bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates and bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates instead.
bCreateUnifiedTexture:bool             # [Deprecated]
unifiedTextureSize:float               # true: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true) The size of unified texture (pixels). Texture will be created in square.
unifiedTextureFillSeamSize:int         # true: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true) Fill texture seam size in pixels.
bUseInifinteSeams:bool                 # true: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true) Use infinite fill texture seam size.
unifiedTextureBakeMargin:float         # true: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true) The margin of the baked texture in the image canvas
unifiedTextureBakeRelateive:bool       # true: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true)
bUnifiedDiffuseMap:bool                # false: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true) export diffuse map baked in the unified uv
bUnifiedNormalMap:bool                 # false: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true) export normal map baked in the unified uv
bUnifiedMetalnessMap:bool              # false: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true) export metalness map baked in the unified uv
bUnifiedRoughnessMap:bool              # false: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true) export roughness map baked in the unified uv
bUnifiedOpacityMap:bool                # false: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true) export opacity map baked in the unified uv
bUnifiedDisplacementMap:bool           # false: (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are true) export displacement map baked in the unified uv
bIncludeHiddenObject:bool              # if true, export all the pattern meshes include 'hidden pattern meshes on 3D' to OBJ
bIncludeInnerShape:bool                # If true, export geometries of internal lines to ease the picking the internal lines in external modeling tools such as Maya and 3ds Max.
scale:float                            # how to scale the object created in CLO when exporting. The default unit of CLO is millimeters for obj/fbx(mm) and gltf(m)
                                       # use 0.001 for gltf in default
axisX:int                              # the index of the axis which the X axis will be converted to. If you don't want axis conversion, set this value as "0"
axisY:int                              # the index of the axis which the Y axis will be converted to. If you don't want axis conversion, set this value as "1"
axisZ:int                              # the index of the axis which the Z axis will be converted to. If you don't want axis conversion, set this value as "2"
bInvertX:bool                          # invert the axis which the X axis will be converted to
bInvertY:bool                          # invert the axis which the Y axis will be converted to
bInvertZ:bool                          # invert the axis which the Z axis will be converted to
bSaveColorWays:bool                    # if true, export for all the colorways.
bSaveInZip:bool                        # If true, export as a zipped file with textures. It will output a single zipped file(.zip), not separated files.
bDiffuseColorCombined:bool             # if true, the texture will be exported after being combined with diffuse color
bExcludeAmbient:bool                   # if true, exclude ambient map and color in MTL files.
bOpacityMap:bool                       # if true, generate an opacity map by extracting alpha channel from diffuse map
bMetaData:bool                         # export meta data
bSizeAndPoseFromAvatar:bool            # ImportAvatar: true = keep the avatar file's own size and pose, false = apply the size and pose saved with the garment
bEmbedded:bool                         # for embedded-gltf export option
bExportLight:bool                      # export light information in gltf
bExportFabric:bool                     # true : Export Fabric (Fabric information)
bSaveColorWaysSingleFile:bool          # true : export gltf with KHR_materials_variants extension (affect when bSaveColorWays is true)
fbxSdkVersion:int                      # 0 : 2020, 1: 2019, 2: 2018, 3: 2016/2017, 4: 2014/2015, 5: 2013, 6: 2012
bIncludeAvatarShape:bool               # FBX / Alembic export: include the avatar meshes; keep it equal to bExportAvatar
m_AuthenticationKeyForAPI:str          # For Alvanon to use extended functionality in the CLO API / SDK
ImportObjectType:int                   # import file type. 0 : Avatar, 1: Trim, 2 : Garment
bAutoTranslate:bool                    # If true, allign bottom to ground
bCreateCamera:bool                     # If true, create object camera
bCreateAvatarJointAnimation:bool       # If true, create object avatar joint animation
bCreateAvatarCacheAnimation:bool       # If true, create object avatar cache animation
bCreateAvatarBlendShapeAnimation:bool  # If true, create object avatar blendshape (weight) animation
bCreateClothCacheAnimation:bool        # If true, create cloth cache animation
bMoveGarment:bool                      # If true, move garment to start position
bAddArrangementPoints:bool             # If true, auto add arrangement points
bAutoCreateFittingSuit:bool            # If true, auto create fitting suit
bAdd:bool                              # If true, set load type as add
translationValueX:float                # set x-offset value per the position-value in 3D Window for Avatar/Garment (left - right) unit (mm)
translationValueY:float                # set y-offset value per the position-value in 3D Window for Avatar/Garment (up - down) unit (mm)
translationValueZ:float                # set z-offset value per the position-value in 3D Window for Avatar/Garment (monitor - user) unit (mm)
bTrace2DPatternsUVMap:bool             # If true, set load type for trace 2d patterns from uv map
bCreateMetallicRoughnessMap:bool       # true : (In case bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates or bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates are false) export metallic-roughness map baked using diffuse alpha value (only in gltf)
bClothUnifiedUVCoordinates:bool        # flag for Cloth Unified UV Coordinates
bAvatarUnifiedUVCoordinates:bool       # flag for Avatar Unified UV Coordinates
patternList:list[int]                  # pattern indices to export (RealPatternList order, as used by the Pattern API)
buttonList:list[ int]                  # uid values of buttons/buttonholes to export, as returned in the "uid" field by GetNonFabricComponentsOnPattern / GetAllNonFabricComponents
graphicList:list[ int]                 # uid values of graphics/prints to export, from the same "uid" field
zipperList:list[ int]                  # uid values of zippers to export, from the same "uid" field; each is expanded to its tapes and slider/puller/stopper hardware

"""
Options for ImportZPRJ as parameters without dialogs in CLO API
"""
bAppend:bool                  # if true, append the project file to the current loaded project
                              # if false, overwrite/replace the project file in the current loaded project
bLoadGarment:bool             # if true, open/add Garment inside the zprj file into the current loaded project
bLoadAvatar:bool              # if true, open/add Avatar inside the zprj file into the current loaded project
translationValueX:float       # set x-offet value per current patterns in 2D Window for Patterns (left - right)
                              # set x-offset value per the position-value inside the zprj file in 3D Window for Avatar/Garment (left - right)
translationValueY:float       # set y-offet value per current patterns in 2D Window for Patterns (up - down)
                              # set y-offset value per the position-value inside the zprj file in 3D Window for Avatar/Garment
translationValueZ:float       # set z-offset value per the position-value inside the zprj file in 3D Window for Avatar/Garment (monitor - user)
translationUnit:CLO_API_UNIT  # translationUnit - 0: Milimeter, 1: Centimeter, 2: Inch, 3: Meter, 4: Feet
bLoadSceneAndProps:bool       # if true, open/add SceneAndProps inside the zprj file into the current loaded project
bLoadRenderProperties:bool    # if true, open/add RenderProperties(Vray) inside the zprj file into the current loaded project
bLoadCustomView:bool          # if true, load Custom View (default: false)
bLoadDisplaySettings:bool     # if true, load Display Settings (default: true)
